invariants.statement: Every semantic entity has exactly one stable identifier.
Every canonical definition has exactly one semantic version.
Released definitions are superseded, never overwritten.
Lifecycle definitions, phase definitions and gate definitions are distinct from runtime instances.
Every gate instance references exactly one versioned gate definition and one case.
Every consequential gate decision is append-only, digest-bound and attributable.
An evidence claim references exactly one artifact, one target and one case scope.
Evidence evaluation is separate from evidence assertion.
Evidence bundles are manifests of digest-bound records, not duplicate evidence stores.
Each cross-framework mapping represents one source version and one target version.
Every assessment and evidence manifest is pinned to an immutable semantic release manifest.
Delivery status and evidence authority class remain separate properties.
Framework guidance does not create legal obligations or deployment authorization.
Non-authoritative monitoring signals require accountable human review before changing case state.
